name: Unbreakable Sorrow
description: The PCs hear the sound of sobbing and feel an overwhelming sense of sorrow, as if they'd lost something more precious to them than their own life.
disable: DC 32 Deception check or DC 32 Performance check (master) to laugh away the sadness, DC 31 Occultism check (expert) to banish the psychic imprint, DC 33 Thievery check (master) to disperse the emotional energy

defensiveAbilities.name: Mourn
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A living creature approaches the statue

Effect The trap deals 4d10+14 mental damage to all creatures in the room (DC 28 basic Will save). On a failed save, a creature additionally falls Prone and begins to weep, taking 1d10 persistent plus mental damage.
